subject.title: fix(sessions): ignore invalid saved timestamps during session recovery

question: Should loose or calendar-invalid historical session timestamp strings become missing metadata immediately, or must a defined subset be preserved through an explicit doctor migration?
rationale: The patch changes how existing persisted session data is interpreted, and repository policy makes fallback and upgrade compatibility an explicit product decision rather than an implementation convenience.

options.title: Accept strict runtime semantics
options.body: Merge with malformed historical strings treated as missing metadata because canonical OpenClaw writers already emit strict ISO timestamps.

options.title: Require migration coverage
options.body: Pause merge and define the exact previously shipped timestamp forms that doctor must normalize before runtime parsing becomes strict.

recommendation.title: Accept strict runtime semantics
recommendation.body: Merge with malformed historical strings treated as missing metadata because canonical OpenClaw writers already emit strict ISO timestamps.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the shared normalization package and current agent-core timestamp validation boundary, making them the strongest available routing candidate for the compatibility decision.
